description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM Lock Relocation Kit is used in conjunction with the newer style Door Bezels/Cases & Handles to move the door locking/unlocking lever to the top of the door rather than it being located in the bezel/case.
So if you need a new OEM lock mechanism, handle or bezel on your 1986-1993 Samurai, now you can still keep the interior door lock/unlock lever by simply installing this kit.
The kit contains everything you need and it is simple to install.
Does BOTH door locks!
Also repairs lock problems on the 1994 and 1995 Samurais.
These parts are all plug and play, no modifications needed.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Door Lock Knob 78241M60002
Qty 2 – CAP, Lock Knob 78242M61000
Qty 1 – Rod, LH Lock 83242M80100
Qty 1 – Rod, RH Lock 83241M80100
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
